title: Mitigating traffic oscillations in mixed traffic flow with scalable deep Koopman predictive control
core_idea: Introduce an adaptive deep Koopman predictive control framework (AdapKoopPC) that learns a linear representation of heterogeneous, nonlinear human-driven vehicle car-following dynamics via a novel AdapKoopNet from naturalistic data and embeds that representation into an MPC to enable scalable, real-time, data-driven control of connected automated vehicles to mitigate traffic oscillations in mixed traffic.
tldr: A data-driven control framework that uses an adaptive deep Koopman network to linearize HDV behavior and integrates it into MPC for scalable, real-time control of CAVs to reduce traffic oscillations in mixed traffic.
